comparison.checkpoint: fixed epoch 0; no evaluation during fitting
comparison.evaluation: the exact frozen 468 component-separated valid row groups; previously exposed
comparison.raw_target_wmse: separate future factor; not part of this pair

prediction_delivery.prediction_input_columns: features only; targets and scored masks are not read
prediction_delivery.row_order: sorted evaluation group IDs recorded in prediction metadata
prediction_delivery.onnx_parity_group: first selected fitting train group; feature-only read

known_comparison_limit: Allocated parameter counts are equal, but linear-control ramp coordinates are identically zero, reducing its effective trainable capacity. A future PLE result is not by itself evidence for spline geometry over generic nonlinear capacity.
grader: Root owns the independent grader and must verify both prediction row-group indexes against the frozen 468 evaluation groups before scoring.
